quest.title: The Replacement's Secret
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

talks.objective: Give the Bamboo Slip to Gendou

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Give the Special Bamboo Slip

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Alright, please pass that Bamboo Slip to me... Huh, actually, you know what? I have the faintest impression that you didn't shake the slip cylinder at all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Really? Must've been a trick of the light.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right. You just weren't paying attention, Ms. Gendou.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: M—Me? Not paying attention? C—Come now, that... that never happened. I just didn't sleep so well last night, that's all. Sorry for worrying you!

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Here's your Fortune Slip.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (How did it go? We should've gotten the powder onto her, right?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Without a hitch, Paimon.)

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Um, why are you two standing there while looking so somber? Did you get a slip with Misfortune on it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No, just a Modest Fortune.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Oh, I wouldn't be too sad about that. A Modest Fortune is not bad, either. Perhaps you might encounter some challenges, but I'm sure that there's a happy ending waiting for you on the other side.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Someone with a heart as good as yours will definitely see such fortunes through. Well, that's what I believe, at least.

talks.objective: Wait for the impostor Gendou at night (21:00 – 23:00)
Wait for the fake Gendou to show up

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, look! There's someone walking out from the shrine!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's our mark, alright! The fake Gendou! She's heading down the mountain. C'mon, after her!

talks.objective: Use Elemental Sight to pursue the fake Gendou

dialogues.speaker: "Gendou Ringo"
dialogues.text: It hasn't come time yet to meet the Teacher, I'm sure of it. In that case, this must be about that incident...

dialogues.speaker: Efim Snezhevich
dialogues.text: Lyudochka.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: Ah, Teacher, you're here!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: Sorry for bothering you. Allow me to make my report. So, concerning your instructions to infiltrate the Shuumatsuban...

dialogues.speaker: Efim Snezhevich
dialogues.text: Enough, Lyudochka. I tire of your delaying tactics.

dialogues.speaker: Efim Snezhevich
dialogues.text: "Frequent contact might raise suspicion," "The Shuumatsuban's direction may change due to the end of the Vision Hunt Decree, I must gather more information"...

dialogues.speaker: Efim Snezhevich
dialogues.text: You always say these things! Tell me. You don't actually have the trust of those two Shuumatsuban members, do you? Why else would you spout all these lies, hoping to stave me off?

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: That's not it, Teacher! They do trust me. I just need a little more time...

dialogues.speaker: Efim Snezhevich
dialogues.text: Time, you say? I have given you more than sufficient time.

dialogues.speaker: Efim Snezhevich
dialogues.text: Understand this. My patience is limited, as is that of Lady Arlecchino.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: My apologies...

dialogues.speaker: Efim Snezhevich
dialogues.text: I did not spend all those years raising you to listen to apologies. What I want are results. Results!

dialogues.speaker: Efim Snezhevich
dialogues.text: ...Forget it. I will not chase down every little detail of this matter. Your inability to win their trust, your present lifestyle getting to your head... None of this matters.

dialogues.speaker: Efim Snezhevich
dialogues.text: I have written your "final instructions" on this sheet of paper. Take it, and read it well.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: Yes, Teacher! I will complete the mission. I will not disappoint you!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: ...Th—This is!?

dialogues.speaker: Efim Snezhevich
dialogues.text: Is something wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: Ah, no. Not at all...

dialogues.speaker: Efim Snezhevich
dialogues.text: Lyudochka. May I take your previous words as your promise?

dialogues.speaker: Efim Snezhevich
dialogues.text: Answer me. Yes? Or no?

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: Teacher! I have no objections to your decision. But... You said that Lady Arlecchino can recall us from Inazuma at any time.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: And at this moment, the Shogunate and Watatsumi Island have reached a ceasefire, so... Is what we're doing really necessary?

dialogues.speaker: Efim Snezhevich
dialogues.text: Hah. That is precisely why our mission has value.

dialogues.speaker: Efim Snezhevich
dialogues.text: Lady Signora may have met her end here in Inazuma, but that makes it the best time for us to repay Lady Arlecchino's kindness and build up her prestige.

dialogues.speaker: Efim Snezhevich
dialogues.text: And I have always told you that as far as we are concerned, "chaos" is the most fertile soil.

dialogues.speaker: Efim Snezhevich
dialogues.text: What are you wavering for, Lyudochka?

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: This way, there will certainly be more orphans...

dialogues.speaker: Efim Snezhevich
dialogues.text: And wouldn't that be well? We can take them in and train them. They will join us — well, provided you complete your mission, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Efim Snezhevich
dialogues.text: Do not disappoint me again, Lyudochka. We go many years back. I have no wish to take things too far.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: Ohh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no, something terrible's going to happen to Watatsumi Island!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Looks like Lyudochka's alone now, {NICKNAME}. Let's find a way to get those final instructions from her!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lyudochka.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: Who's there!?

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: #You... {NICKNAME}, why are you here?

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: That, I... No, you misunderstand! I... I was here because...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't think I'm misunderstanding anything.

choices.text: You responded when I called you "Lyudochka."

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: ...Well, well, I suppose there's no point saying anything now.

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: Now that you've exposed my true identity, I can't let you leave alive!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: *cough* Ugh... *pants*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry. I didn't quite hold back enough.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: *pants* Why... aren't you finishing me off?

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: You must be trying to get those final instructions from me. Well? Wouldn't it be simpler to just be rid of me first?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That would certainly be simple, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I suppose that might even be a release for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Gendou... No, Ms. Lyudochka. We can tell, y'know? You came at us pretty hard at first, but you weren't serious at all while the two of you were fighting, were you?

choices.text: Your attacks were pretty fake, too.

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: Eh? I... I wasn't faking it that much, was I?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, you were certainly trying to finish things — for yourself, at least.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ms. Lyudochka, we overheard your conversation with that Teacher of yours. Things... seem kinda tough. Could you tell us what happened? We can help you!

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: But I... I'm a Fatuus.

choices.text: Paimon said we would help — and so we will.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Aw, thanks, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! Don't you worry, we don't hurt good people!

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: I... I wouldn't call myself a good person.

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: At first, I only infiltrated the Grand Narukami Shrine so that I could make contact with members of the Shuumatsuban and infiltrate their ranks in turn.

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: But imagine my surprise when I found out that the two Shuumatsuban members the Teacher spoke of were, in fact, the Traveler — famed for their deeds in Mondstadt and Liyue — and their servitor.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's not a... servitor, or whatever!

choices.text: No wonder you knew my name.

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: Correct. As such, I knew that the Shuumatsuban infiltration was a bust from the start.

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: But the Teacher had such great expectations for this operation, so I didn't know how to report this to him. If he knew the truth, his wrath would be... That wouldn't have ended well for me.

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: And yet, coming to Inazuma, becoming a shrine maiden... It was all like a dream! And I would have been satisfied just being able to dream this dream.

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: So I kept finding reasons to procrastinate and prevaricate, trying to take everything one day at a time.

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: I thought that my lies would fall through one day. I certainly never expected the Teacher to not pursue the matter, but give me a new mission instead.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What mission did he give you, anyway? You went pale as a sheet the moment you read that note!

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: That's because my mission... is "to poison."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: P—Poison!?

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: The Teacher has ordered me and several others to enter Watatsumi Island and poison the land, before intentionally exposing our respective identities as a shrine maiden at the Grand Narukami Shrine and soldiers of the Tenryou Commission.

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: That way, we would stir up conflict between the Shogunate and Watatsumi Island, which would give us, the Fatui, a chance to enter the equation.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That "Teacher" of yours... What a wicked person! If that plan went through, all the work people have put in to re-establish peace in Inazuma would go right down the drain!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So what do you plan to do, Lyudochka?

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: I... I don't know. I don't have the right to oppose the Teacher's orders, but I don't want to see such a thing happen!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's because you're a "Snezhevna," right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Come to think of it, Paimon's heard that word used a lot. What does that mean? You already seem to know, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's used to refer to orphans, isn't it?

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: That's correct. "Snezhevich" and "Snezhevna" are surnames the Fatui give to orphans they take in, like us.

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: We grew up in an orphanage set up by Lady Arlecchino. We do not know who we truly are. At the most, we know the blood that flows through our veins.

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: It was due to my Inazuman heritage that I studied matters concerning this land since I was young.

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: In fact, my Teacher is also a Snezhevich. That's why I can't understand... No. That's why I cannot forgive him for saying those things.

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: I've always been thinking to myself: who am I, really? Why was I left all alone? Did my parents meet with some unfortunate fate? Or did they abandon me?

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: But the way the Teacher completely disregarded the suffering of orphans... I couldn't help but wonder: was my fate a creation of the Fatui? Of people like the Teacher?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Truly unforgivable.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, we've gotta help Ms. Lyudochka. She might be with the Fatui, but she isn't a bad person.

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: Thank you for your sentiments, but I suspect that my course is already set. The Teacher will have no mercy on traitors. As long as I live, he will find me.

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: Perhaps meeting my fate at your hands might have been best.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is that the only way you can get away from him? That can't be!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh. Wait. Paimon's remembering something...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Momoyo, yes?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Momoyo? Right! Paimon's got it now. She was making some cad—

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Hush.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahem! *cough* So basically, Ms. Lyudochka, we've come up with a way to save you — and foil your Teacher's awful plot in the process!

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: Huh? Really?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't you worry about a thing! Still, you'd best find a place to lie low for the next few days. You can come out once we're done settling everything.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Do you know of any place to go? Someplace we can find you but that no one will suspect might be best!

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: Let me think...

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: Ah, there is one place. I once worked at Yae Publishing House as a proofreader for new novel releases under a pseudonym. I... really loved their novels.

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: They have a small room behind their bookstore in Inazuma City, which is sometimes used by proofreaders — or authors behind on their manuscript submissions.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That sounds like a fine spot!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Talk about "hidden in plain sight."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ms. Lyudochka, just hide out in that spot for a bit. We'll come looking for you if anything crops up.

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: I understand. I... really don't know how I should thank you. I mean, I've been deceiving you all this time...

response.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
response.text: The Teacher wrote the details of our mission on the piece of paper he gave me. Here. The lives of the innocents of Watatsumi Island are in your hands now.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Lyudochka departs.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She's gone. We'd best head back to see Momoyo. Looks like we've still got quite a few important things to get done.

choices.text: No wonder you knew about us.
Well, if you really are in trouble here...
Your laughter was plenty fake, too.

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: You're only back now? Well then. Did you get the intel?

talks.objective: Report back to Momoyo and talk to her

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: Not bad. With this, we should be able to foil the Fatui's scheme. I will get people to perform follow-up operations immediately. You need no longer worry.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Actually, Momoyo, we've got something to ask of you...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Momoyo the details of what happened.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh, Momoyo, stop staring at Paimon. Um... Just say something, would you?

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: You want to save a Fatuus? What has that got to do with me!?

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: That woman replaced me, you know? If it wasn't for your overly fortuitous bumbling, the Shuumatsuban might be in a crisis right now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Um, {NICKNAME}, help Paimon out here! If we can't convince Momoyo, Ms. Lyudochka's life might be in danger!

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: Hmph. That won't work on me. I will not associate with these Fatui!

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: Do you two think that making cadavers is so simple? I've been working day and night this whole time you've been out fishing for intel to finish the work I currently had.

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: You need this much <color=#00E1FFFF>Raw Meat</color> to constitute one person's weight! And then you also need to smelt <color=#00E1FFFF>White Iron Chunks</color> together with a plethora of other ingredients to make fake bones!

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: And without any <color=#00E1FFFF>Sea Ganoderma</color>, the body will not contain sufficient fat. It won't look convincing at all.

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: And putting the <color=#00E1FFFF>clothes</color> on the fake cadaver is just the worst when you need to create any realistic burns. Go too far, and those clothes will be all but unrecognizable!

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: What? Did you both go deaf? What are you standing around for? <color=#00E1FFFF>Eight hunks of Raw Meat, four White Iron Chunks, and three Sea Ganoderma</color>, plus one set of clearly identifiable <color=#00E1FFFF>clothes</color>!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We knew you were a great person, Momoyo!

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: Ugh, just scram! Quit bugging me already!

choices.text: Make your best pitiful puppy-dog expression.
Make your best pitiful puppy-dog expression, plus imminent tears.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: I'll continue to work as a proofreader here for now. I pray for your success.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How's the proofreading going, by the way?

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: It's going quite smoothly, but there's a lot of content to go through. And considering that Yae Publishing House will be short-handed for the next two days... It'll be a long night, I think.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That sounds tough!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: Haha. It is, but I find it fascinating! Being able to read the novels I love in advance, and even touch the hand-written manuscripts themselves... Ah, it's so wonderful!

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: Go on, quickly now. Get the powder onto that fake, and we'll be able to track her using Elemental Sight.

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: The Fatui are surely up to no good on Watatsumi Island. But now that the Tenryou Commission isn't covering for them, they can forget about trying anything funny.

talks.objective: Obtain a set of Lyudochka's clothes

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ms. Lyudochka, are you there?

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: #Ah, it's {NICKNAME} and Paimon. Did something not go as planned? Don't worry, I'll leave this place immediately. I won't trouble you any further...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, no! We came here because our current plan requires a set of your clothes — we'll need a set with which people can identify you immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: A highly-identifiable set of clothes? Alright.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: This is my Fatui uniform. Those who know me should be able to recognize this set in particular.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Feels kinda warm to the touch.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: Ah, I apologize, but I was wearing it under my other clothes in case of an emergency.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright. Now that we have this set of clothes, this plan should go off without a hitch!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudochka Snezhevna
dialogues.text: Thank you, and best of luck.

dialogues.speaker: Riku
dialogues.text: Ah, an outlander! Hello!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you see anything earlier?

dialogues.speaker: Riku
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, I did.

dialogues.speaker: Riku
dialogues.text: I saw a shrine maiden lady walk over there... and then turn all purple, like, fwoosh! Then she flew away! That was super cool!

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: You're back.

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: Hmph. When did I say that I wanted these materials?

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: But now that you've laid them out in front of me, I suppose I can help you. Your intelligence will save many lives, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: Raw Meat, White Iron Chunks, Sea Ganoderma... These will do.

talks.objective: Hand over the set of Lyudochka's clothes

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: So, do you have some clothes with which people can easily identify Lyudochka?

talks.objective: Ask Momoyo to start making the fake cadaver

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: Alright, everything's ready. What happens after this is none of your business.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What about the operation that's happening on Watatsumi Island?

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: I had it arranged while you were out looking for these materials.

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: The item you need will take a whole day to craft, so come back tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: When that time comes, we will talk about how we might use this dummy body.

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: The crafting will take a whole day, so come back tomorrow. Stop floating around me, you'll ruin my mood.

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: The materials are <color=#00E1FFFF>eight hunks of Raw Meat</color>, <color=#00E1FFFF>four White Iron Chunks</color>, and <color=#00E1FFFF>three Sea Ganoderma</color>. Plus one set of <color=#00E1FFFF>clothes</color> with which to distinguish Lyudochka.

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: If you've got it, get going! I still need to arrange the operation to capture the Fatui on Watatsumi Island.
